items.title: Chitwan beat Janakpur to strengthen playoff hopes
items.blurb: Chitwan recovered from a shaky start to chase down a target of 89 with four wickets to spare, leaving Janakpur’s playoff hopes hanging in the balance.

items.title: Janakpur collapse against Chitwan in must-win match
items.blurb: The first-season champions managed just 88 for nine, dealing a major blow to their slim hopes of reaching the Nepal Premier League playoffs.

items.title: Community forests turn to tourism, but potential remains untapped
items.blurb: Jeep, elephant and boat safaris bring in millions for some forests but most of Chitwan’s 93 forests outside the park buffer zone have yet to follow suit.

items.title: Nepali negotiators at COP31 cling to hope for mountain agenda
items.blurb: Nepal, Bhutan and other mountain countries are pushing for measures to save glaciers and mountain ecosystems.

items.title: Nepal seeks mountain-specific early warning systems after devastating flood
items.blurb: Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal calls for better cross-border data sharing, improved high-altitude monitoring and predictable climate finance to protect vulnerable communities.

items.title: 10 killed, five injured as electric microbus plunges off road in Makawanpur
items.blurb: The vehicle was carrying passengers from Sarlahi returning home for Chhath. The driver and one passenger have been identified, while a three-year-old boy was rescued alive.
